== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata 2)]] (Virtual Block 2 slip 72E, 0 side), showing the '''PC-E2 (0 side)''' game text, the current text (made before the PC-E1 errata of 21 September 2012 was found, hence the file name). No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]] (original) and [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, shown by the E-marked Players Committee card image [[:File:VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif]]); the 7 side of PC-E1 and PC-E2 is shown by the Players Committee card image [[:File:VB2-D-imperialcontrol-pre.gif]].

* '''Text source:''' [[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]).
* '''PC-E1 (0 side) text:''' “Deploy Hoth system, [Virtual Block 6] Ice Plains, and [Virtual Block 8] Main Power Generators. May deploy Imperial Decree. For remainder of game, AT-ATs deploy -1 to marker sites. Walker Garrison may only be played once per game and is [Immune to Sense]. Non-[Virtual Block 8] You May Start Your Landing is canceled. While this side up, Revolution is canceled. Once during your turn, may ▲ one AT-AT Cannon, Hoth Blockade, Electro-Rangefinder, or a [Hoth] Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators ‘blown away’ and Hoth Blockade on Hoth.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1002_L6400</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1002_L6400</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E1 (0 side) game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
